statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to guide further management of unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Advance approval was required to ensure medical necessity for this diagnostic monitoring service
